name: max-game
description: Max's Overworld - a browser overworld game

scripts.build: npm run generate:dialogues && tsc && npm run bundle
scripts.generate:dialogues: npm run generate:noel-dialogue && npm run generate:mike-dialogue
scripts.watch: npm run generate:dialogues && esbuild js/main.ts js/internal.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name]-bundle --format=iife --watch
scripts.watch:bundle: npm run generate:dialogues && esbuild js/main.ts js/internal.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name]-bundle --format=iife --watch
